services.name: front
services.description: the gRPC front door (creates the schema and the topic at start)

invariants.msg: every order row in MySQL has the amount its id implies (100000 + id)
invariants.cmd:
n=$(SQL -e "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stack.orders WHERE amount <> 100000 + id" 2>/dev/null) || exit 2
echo "rows with a wrong amount: $n"; [ "$n" = 0 ]

invariants.msg: a cached order in Redis never holds a wrong amount (a missing key is allowed)
invariants.cmd:
/bin/redis-cli -p 6379 ping 2>/dev/null | grep -q PONG || exit 2
bad=0; i=0
while [ $i -lt $NORDERS ]; do
  v=$(/bin/redis-cli -p 6379 GET order:$i 2>/dev/null)
  if [ -n "$v" ] && [ "$v" != $((100000 + i)) ]; then echo "order:$i = $v"; bad=1; fi
  i=$((i + 1))
done
[ $bad = 0 ] && echo "no wrong cached amount"
[ $bad = 0 ]

invariants.msg: every ACKed order is in MySQL and Kafka exactly once; nothing told 'failed' was applied
invariants.cmd:
/bin/hydostack-client oracle $NORDERS $HYDO_ACKED $HYDO_FAILED > /tmp/hydo/oracle.log 2>&1
grep -a "HYDO-ORACLE" /tmp/hydo/oracle.log | tail -1
grep -a "HYDO-ORACLE" /tmp/hydo/oracle.log | tail -1 | grep -q "HYDO-ORACLE: OK"

invariants.msg: what the gRPC proxy saw, per outcome (a count; always holds)
